ZONINGLOTDEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT THIS ZONING LOT DEVELOPMENT AGREEMENT(this"Agreement"), made as of , 2003, by and between TWIN TOWER EQUITIES,LLC., having an address at d/o'BLDG Management, 52 Vanderbilt Avenue, 16th Floor, New York, New York 10017 (hereinafter referred to as"Owner") and PARK PLACE PARTNERS, LLC.,having an address at 85 North Street, Suite 500, New York, New York (hereinafter referred to as"Developer"). WITNESSETH: WHEREAS, Owner is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City and State of New York, County of Kings, known as and by the street address 296-302Flatbush Avenue and the tax lot Block 939,Lots 39,40,41 and 42 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-1 annexed hereto and made a part of hereof (said land and tax lots being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future additions, alterations and replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Building"; and said land and buildings and improvements being hereinafter referred to as "Owner's Property"); WHEREAS, Developer is the owner in fee title of a certain parcel of land, with the buildings and improvements thereon, in the City, and State of New York, County of Kings, known as and by the street addresses 286-292Flatbush Avenue a/k/a 135-149Park Place and the tax lot Block 939, Lot 35 and more particularly described in Exhibit A-2 annexed hereto and made a part thereof (said land and tax lots being referred to herein as "Developer's Land"); WHEREAS, Developer intends,to construct a new building or modify or alter the existing building upon all or a portion of Developer's Land (said new building or modification of the existing building, with any further additions, alterations and replacements thereof, being herein called the"New Building"; and said land and New Building and improvements, together with any future replacements thereof being hereinafter referred to as "Developer's Property"); Owner's Land and Developer's Land are herein sometimes jointly referred to as the "Parcels" and each individually as a"Parcel"); WHEREAS, it is contemplated that the New Building will contain more floor area (herein referred to as "Floor Area"), as that term is defined in the Zoning Resolution of the City of New York effective December 15, 1961 (the"Zoning Resolution"), than is now available for use under the "floor area ratio" limitation contained in the present Zoning Resolution related to Developer's Land as an independent "zoning lot", with the result that Developer desires to utilize the procedure available under the Zoning Resolution for combining Developer's Land and Owner's Land into a single "zoning lot" for the purpose of determining compliance by the New Building with such limitation;
